keywords.indexterm: components of the hybrid/plug-in hybrid vehicle service interlock connector

conbody.p: The service interlock connector, located within the motor compartment, is a safety device that disables the high voltage battery. This function is for vehicle inspections at an authorized Kia dealer.
To access the service interlock connector, open the hood, and find it near the fuse box.

li.p: To prevent severe injury or death from electric shock, avoid touching the service interlock connector.
If the service interlock connector requires inspection or maintenance, have the vehicle inspected by an authorized Kia dealer.
Only disconnect or tamper with the service interlock connector in an emergency. Doing so might cause significant issues with the vehicle, such as failure to start.
